species: Here, we extend the phenotypic characterization of N-glycosylation pathway mutants in Haloferax volcanii and provide a detailed glycoproteome for this model archaeon through the mass spectrometric analysis of intact glycopeptides.
disease_state: Using in-depth glycoproteomic datasets generated for the wild-type (WT) and mutant strains as well as a reanalysis of datasets within the Archaeal Proteome Project (ArcPP), we identify the largest archaeal glycoproteome described so far.
sample_source: provide a detailed glycoproteome for this model archaeon through the mass spectrometric analysis of intact glycopeptides.
strain: Hfx. volcanii H53, as well as the $\Delta aglB$ and $\Delta agl15$ mutants, was grown at 45°C in liquid or on solid agar semi-defined casamino acid (Hv-Cab) medium.
